# LuxiRisk v0.1 binaries

Closed-source evaluation binaries. Matching `.sha256` files ship beside each
binary. Prefer verifying the digest before first run.

| File | Platform |
|------|----------|
| `luxirisk-macos-arm64` | macOS Apple Silicon |
| `luxirisk-linux-x86_64` | Linux x86_64 |
| `luxirisk-windows-x86_64.exe` | Windows x86_64 |

Also attach these to the GitHub Release tag **`luxirisk-v0.1`**.

Engine source is **not** published. Formulas and test vectors:
[`../FORMULAS.md`](../FORMULAS.md), [`../test-vectors/`](../test-vectors/).
